rooms.name: The Immortal Map Room
rooms.desc:
Here is an entrance way to a very interesting zone.  There is a lot of
trickery involved in the location of rooms and exits.  Please let me know
if there are any bugs or glitches.  There is no map.  This zone consists of
about 190 rooms that are fairly loosely connected, so I don't even want to
try and show it.  The best way to find your way about this zone is to do it
just as a mortal would, walk around and explore.  You can go down to the 
beginning room.  There is a sign floating here.

rooms.name: A Strange Doorway
rooms.desc:
You are in some kind of strange portal.  You are standing, but when you
look though the portal, you appear to be staring at the sky, almost as though
you were lying down.  You have to go up to climb out of here, or you can go
south to return to the hallway.

rooms.name: A Strange Doorway
rooms.desc:
This is a weird feeling.  You are standing on level ground, but when you look
directly in front of you you appear to be looking directly at the ground 5 feet
below you.  This is nearly nauseating.  You have to drop down to get onto a
grassy field or you can return south to the hallway.

rooms.name: A Strange Doorway
rooms.desc:
You are standing a some kind of doorway peering into the relative darkness of
a tunnel.  There is a flurry of activity ahead of you.  There are two pairs
of glowing eyes staring about the tunnel, but they do not seem to notice
you at all.  The tunnel is just north of here, or you can return south to
the hallway.

rooms.name: Beginning Of A Hallway
rooms.desc:
A strange light flickers around you as you stand at this dead end of a hallway.
You know you have been here before... this is where that portal was, the one
that is not here any more.  The only exit is to the east.

rooms.name: Beginning Of A Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is a strange place.  To your east is a long, stone hallway.  It is lit 
but you have no idea how, there are no torches or glowing balls of light.
There is an eerie fell to this place, the hairs on you neck are standing on
end.

rooms.name: The Hallway
rooms.desc:
The stone hallway about you is perfect.  The corners are square and there is
no sign of any stone mortar.  The source of the light is still unknown.  The
hallway leads on the east or returns to the west.  There are two wooden
doors, one to your north and one to the south.   There is a small plaque
embedded in the floor here.

rooms.name: The Hallway
rooms.desc:
The perfect hallway continues.  There is still no sign of the source of
light.  There is another pair of wooden doors here, and another plaque is
embedded into the floor.

rooms.name: End Of The Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is then end of the perfectly constructed hallway.  There are two more
wooden doors, one to the north, the other to the south.  There is also a
much larger wooded door to the east, perhaps a closer look is in order.  The
hallway leads back to the west.  There is another plaque embedded here.

rooms.name: A Strange Doorway
rooms.desc:
This doorway opens onto a dusty road.  Ahead of you is a small abandoned
town.  You can go south onto the road or head back north to the hallway.

rooms.name: A Strange Doorway
rooms.desc:
You are faced with a line of trees as you look to the south.  There is enough 
room for you to walk out of the doorway, but little else.  The path you could
step onto leads east and west, and you are guessing there is something to the
north of you, once you get out of this unusual gateway.  You can head back
north into the hallway.

rooms.name: A Strange Doorway
rooms.desc:
As you enter the doorway you are looking at a large courtyard.  The ground is
covered in a white powder like stone.  A huge black tower casts its shadow
over the open area.  You can also go back into the hallway to the north.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
This is the north-west corner of a smallish battle field.  You are betting 
that a war has been fought here for a very long time.  You can go south or
east from here.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
This is some kind of mini-battle field where soldiers can practice their
skills or more likely actually wage a war.  You can go east, west or south
from here.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
You are along the northern edge of this battle field.  There are woods to your
north so your only options in places to go are east, west and south.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
This is the north-east corner of the battle-field.  There is some sort of
castle to your east.  There is some kind of entry door south-east of here.
You can go south or west.

rooms.name: A Kitchen
rooms.desc:
This kitchen has not been used for what looks like hundreds of years.  You
bet those beings that live here do not need food to survive.  You can leave
to the east.

rooms.name: A Dinning Room
rooms.desc:
There is a huge table in the middle of this room surrounded by what was once
plush chairs.  Everything has fallen into disrepair and ruin.  It looks as
though many a battle have been faught, won, and lost here.  You can head east,
west, or south from here.

rooms.name: A Storage Closet
rooms.desc:
This is another room falling to pieces.  The shelves that are now collapsed or
caving in were once filled with all sorts of expensive goods.  There is
nothing of value here anymore.  You can go west back to the dinning room.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
You are at the end of a large battle field.  It looks as though some kind of
battle has been going on for centuries.  The grass basically non-existent and
the bones of people long ago killed are partially buried.  There is some
clanging in the air.

rooms.name: Middle Of A Field
rooms.desc:
You seem to be in the middle of a war.  There are bone shards and armor bits
from long-dead soldiers.  But the ground looks as though it has been beaten
down recently.  There is a castle off to the east of here.  You can go north,
east, south, or west.

rooms.name: Middle Of A Field
rooms.desc:
This is some kind of mini-battle field where soldiers can practice their
skills or more likely actually wage a war.  There is a castle not to far
east of here.  You can go east, west, north or south from here.

rooms.name: At A Castle
rooms.desc:
You are at the far edge of a field at the entrance to a once grand, but now
run down castle.  You can go east into the castle or into the field to the
west, north, or south.

rooms.name: The Entrance Way
rooms.desc:
You can tell this castle used to be grand by just looking at this entrance.
There are remnants of large wall tapestries and plush carpeting all around
you.  This place has been scarred by time and abuse.  You can go east into
the main part of the castle or west, back onto the field.

rooms.name: The Main Chamber
rooms.desc:
This must have been the king's throne room.  There is an altar-like dias at
the eastern edge of the room with a door beyond it.  A pile of broken wood
sits atop that platform.  There are doors to the north and south, and you
can go back to the entrance in the west.

rooms.name: The Anti-Chamber
rooms.desc:
This is a relatively small chamber, given that it was used by a king.  It is
in complete ruin.  You are surprised that the roof is staying up.  The main
chamber is west of here.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
This is the south-west corner of a mini-battle field.  It is well beaten down
from man years of constant battle.  You can go north or east from here.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
You are along the southern edge of a battle field.  This place looks like it
is hell for the soldiers who fight here, no cover, no backup, no nothing.
Whatever they are fighting for better be damn importaint.  You can go east,
west or north from here.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
You are closer to the eastern edge of the battle field.  There is some kind of
castle to the north east of you.  You can go east, west, or north.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
This si the south-east corner of the battle field.  There is a castle just to
the north-east of you.  It is reachable by going to an enterance way north of
you.  You can also go west from here.

rooms.name: A Show Room
rooms.desc:
At one time a great collection of armor and weapons was displayed here.  All
that is left is collapsed display cases and rusted hunks of metal.  A hallway
is to the east.

rooms.name: A Small Hallway
rooms.desc:
This room is in the same condition as the rest of the castle - delapidated.
To the west is some kind of display area and some kind of quarters are to
the east.  The main chamber is just north of here.

rooms.name: Some Sleeping Quarters
rooms.desc:
This place is a mess.  It was probably a mess before the room basically caved
in on itself.  There are a few wooden beds and dressers rotting away here.
It is hard to imagine anyone ever living here.  The hallway is to the west.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
This is the corner of a grassy moor.  It is a very relaxing place.  The only
exit is to the east.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
The grass of this moor has a very soft, relaxing feeling to it.  You can go
east south, or west from here.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
The more you wander about this grassy field, the more you wonder if there is
danger somewhere around.  You can go east, south, or west from here.

rooms.name: A Low Spot In The Moor
rooms.desc:
Your last thought as you suffocate in the wet peat is that you should have
been more careful where you walked...

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
Just to the east of you is a small building.  This seems very out of place on
the grassy moor.  You can also go south.

rooms.name: A Small Hut
rooms.desc:
This place is unreal.  It is spotlessly clean, there must be a reason for
it to be in the middle of nowhere.  There is a wooden oval on the east wall
with a brass plaque over it.  You can go back to the moor via the door to
the west.

rooms.name: A Hollow In The Moor
rooms.desc:
Your last thought as you suffocate in the wet peat is that you should have
been more careful where you walked...

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
You are having a wonderful time strolling in this open grass field.  You begin
to wonder why there is no one else around.  You can go north, south or east 
from here.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
This is an amazingly relaxing place.  The lush green grass feels springy
beneath you feet.  You can go north, east, or west to navigate in the moor.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
The grass beneath you feet spring back as you step off of it.  You can only
imagine how great a garden would grow here.  You can go west or south from
here.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
This path is a little firmer than a majority of the moor.  You can imagine
the reason for this is an increase in use.  But where is that use coming
from?  You can go north or south here.

rooms.name: A Grassy More
rooms.desc:
The grassy feels springy under your feet as you walk along.  This place is
invigorating.  To the north is what looks like a low spot on an otherwise
level field.  You can also go south and east.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
Ahhh... The great outdoors.  You are invigorated by the sweet smell of the
grass.  You can go north or west from here.

rooms.name: A Wet Patch
rooms.desc:
Ack!  You are being pulled under as the grass below your feet gives way.
The last thing you can think of is how this wonderful place can hide such
dangers.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
This place is quite relaxing.  You feel the urge to spread out a blanket
and have a picnic right here.  You can continue north or east.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
This part of the path seems a little more traveled.  The grass is not packed
down and there is not dirt path, but there are signs of use.  You can go
north, south, or west from here.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
You are in the west side of this large open field.  The grass around you is
luscious green and fresh.  It is quite relaxing.  You can go north or south.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
The open expance of lush grass continues here.  You are getting a peaceful
feeling as you walk.  Exits lead east or south.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
This is a slight rise in the fairly level field.  You can see the woods
surrounding the moor in all four directions.  Just to your north, the grass
looks a little wet.  You can also go east, south, or west.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
This path seems a little more worn that what you had seen.  But even so, the
grass is not trampled or even lying on its side.  In fact, you have no idea
how you think this path is used more often.  You can go east or west from
here.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
This is the eastern edge of the moor.  There are trees to the east forming
a barrier so you can not go that way.  But you can go north, south, or west.

rooms.name: A Grassy Field
rooms.desc:
This is a corner of a large grassy field.  It does not quite look like a
field though, it has a more springy, luscious look to it.  You can go
north or east from here.  You swear there was a sign here, but it is no
longer where it was, or are you imagining things?

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
This is a wonderful place.  The air is clean and the sky clear.  You think
you might be able to spend all day relaxing here.  You can go north or
west from here.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
This place is great!  You bet you could almost live right here, if you
did not have that longing for adventure.  The moor heads north or east to
a spot that looks a lot more wet than the rest of the moor.

rooms.name: A Wet Hollow
rooms.desc:
Ack!  You knew it, this place was too good to be true!  You last thoughts
are: "How can such a beautiful place be so deadly!"  You think this as
your head sinks bellow the surface into the peat moss.

rooms.name: A Grassy Moor
rooms.desc:
This is the south-west corner of the moor.  The grass here, is as green and
lush as it is anywhere else on the moor.  You can only go north from here.

rooms.name: A Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This is the end of the tunnel.  It is a little more open here, and seems
familiar to you.  That's it.  The strange doorway came into this room, still
no sign of it.  You can leave east, through the only exit.

rooms.name: A Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This is a T in the dirt tunnel.  The ground and walls are made up of a well
packed dirt.  There are exits to the east, south, and west.

rooms.name: A Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The tunnel is a little tighter here, but it seems no less used.  The ground
is just as packed down as the larger paths.  On the walls are some strange
holes, very small when compaired to the tunnels, but bigger than your fist.
You can go east or west.

rooms.name: A Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This is a T in the tunnels.  It looks a lot like all the other parts of
this underground maze-work of tunnels.  You can go east, west, or south
from here.  The path to the east looks like it curves to the south

rooms.name: A Hidden Tunnel Room
rooms.desc:
The enterance to this room was maticulously made to be hidden from the common
observer but yet easy to open and access.  This is some kind of storage room.
There are a lot of big, expensive treasures here, everything from paintings
to huge wooden chests.  Most of this stuff looks too big for even two men
to haul around.  You can head back into the tunnels to the east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This is a corner in the underground passageways.  The tunnels lead off north
and east.  There are strange holes perferating the sides and ceiling.

rooms.name: A Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This is the continuation of these underground tunnels.  It leads east-west.
There seems to be a bit more activity here as you traverse deaper and deaper
into the tunnels away from the strange doorway from where you came.

rooms.name: A Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This is a T in the dark, dirt tunnels.  The walls and ceiling are still
covered in the fist sized holes.  You really wonder what they are used for.
You can go north, east, or west from here.

rooms.name: A Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This is the end of a east-west tunnel.  The holes are still all around you.
You can go north, south, or west.  The tunnel to the north seems to curve
west as you peer into it.

rooms.name: An Open Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This is the north-west corner of a large open tunnel.  On the walls and
ceiling all around you are more of those fist-sized holes.  You can go south
or east in this open area.

rooms.name: An Open Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This is the north-east corner of the open tunnel.  Those strange holes are on
the ceiling and walls here as well.  You can go south or west from here.

rooms.name: A Small Nook
rooms.desc:
This is seamingly the heart of the tunnels.  There is only one exit to the
east but there is some kind of strange doorway to the west.  You would have
to guess that this is the only way out of these tunnels.

rooms.name: An Open Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This is the west side of an open tunnel.  It is much larger than the other
tunnels you have been in.  You would guess that this is some kind of living
area.  You can stay in the large tunnel by going north, east, or south.  Or
you can go into a small nook to the west.

rooms.name: An Open Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This is a great improvement over the tunnels to to your east.  You actually
have head room here.  This is some sort of large chamber, probably with a
hundred purposes.  You can go north, west, or south to stay in the open
tunnel or you can go east to go back into the smaller tunnels.

rooms.name: A Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This is the same basic style tunnel with the same constuction including thos
strange holes on the walls and ceiling.  You can go east or west from here.

rooms.name: A Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This is a turn in the tunnels.  Other than the fact the tunnel bends here it
look just like the rest.  You can go north or west here.

rooms.name: An Open Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This is the south-west corner of the open tunnel/chamber.  There are still
lots of those strange holes in the walls here.  You can continue in this
tunnel by heading east or north.

rooms.name: An Open Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This is the south-east corner of the open tunnel.  More holes cover the walls
here.  You can go north or west from here.

rooms.name: A Bedroom
rooms.desc:
This is some kind of simple bedroom with a four post bed.  The bed posts have
marks in them from some kind of abrasion.  You begin to wonder what could
cause those marks, and more to the point, you wonder if it might be fun.
There is a door to the south.

rooms.name: A Bedroom
rooms.desc:
This room is dusty from lack of use.  It at one point must have been quite a
place.  There are velvet and silk reminants on the walls and on the bed.  Too
bad it is so out of use.  There is a door to the south.

rooms.name: A Bedroom
rooms.desc:
This room is done up in some kind of theme.  There are brass rings on
opposite walls from which deteriated felt ropes hang.  There is a rack on one
wall that has a bunch of leather sticks and whips on it.  You wonder what
kind of activity this room was used for.  There is a doorway to the south.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is the end of the dusty hallway.  There is a window looking west and
doorways to the north and south.  You can also go east in the hallway.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
Everything seems to be covered in a thick dust, undisterbed by any living
things for what seems centuries. The hallway leads in both birections here.
There are two small rooms north and south from here as well.

rooms.name: Top Of The Stairs
rooms.desc:
There is a thick layer of dust everywhere.  It seems no one has touched this
place for centuries.  A hallway leads off east-west from here, and the stairs
lead back down.

rooms.name: A Hallway
rooms.desc:
The dust continues here, it feels really strange to walk in such a place.
There is a window looking east over what should be the town here.  Doorways
lead north to a bedroom, and south to some kind of office.  The hallway leads
back west to the stairs from here.

rooms.name: A Bedroom
rooms.desc:
This is another dusty room.  There is a large heart shaped bed in the middle
and dusty mirrors on many of the walls and the ceiling.  What would anyone
need all those mirrors for anyway?  The only exit is back north into the
hallway.

rooms.name: A Bedroom
rooms.desc:
This is a smallish bedroom.  There is no bed here, but a very large couch
that looks quite inviting to sleep on.  A thick layer of dust is over
everything here as well.  You can go north back into the hallway.

rooms.name: An Office
rooms.desc:
This looks like it was a well used office, back when it actually was used.
Now it just sits idle collecting dust.  What kind of buisness would you run
out of an upstairs office in some kind of boarding house anyway? You can go
north back to the hallway.

rooms.name: An Abandoned Store
rooms.desc:
There is a empty counter and some empty shelves covered in a thick dust in
this long abandoned store.  You wonder what they might have sold here.  The
furniture looks sturdy and well built, maybe it was weapons or armor or big
metal pots.

rooms.name: An Abandoned Store
rooms.desc:
This is a dusty little shop, long since abandoned.  There are ample hooks on
the ceiling and out from the walls.  There is nothing hanging from them
though.  There is a good solid counter here.  It looks more solid than most
counters.  A small sign is hanging, covered in dust, from the wall.  The only
exit is to the south.

rooms.name: An Abandoned Reception
rooms.desc:
Unlike most of the shops in this town, you know exactly what this room once
was.  It was a reception to some kind of hotel and some kind of tavern.
There is a bar along the far wall with some inverted stools atop it and a
stair case going up in the far back.  Along the side is a reception desk,
complete with a bell.  On the other side are some chairs and couches for the
patrons.  It has fallen into some disrepair and a thick dust covers
everything, but the place looks like it is in good shape.  In adition to the
stairs leading up, a door leads back to the dusty street south of you.

rooms.name: An Abandoned Store
rooms.desc:
This is a nearly empty store of some kind.  There are strange racks covering
the walls on three sides.  There is a small table or counter pushed up
against the back wall.  The only exit is south back to the dusty road.

rooms.name: A Dusty Road
rooms.desc:
This is the edge of the dusty town.  From here you can head into town by
going east, or you can head west along the dusty road.  There is something
strange about that road to the west.  You can't quite place it.  Ah well,
it is probablly nothing that importaint.

rooms.name: A Dusty Road
rooms.desc:
You are basically at the western end of a dusty road.  To your north appears
to be some kind of abandoned store, the same to your south.  The road leads
both east and west from here.

rooms.name: A Dusty Road
rooms.desc:
You are just about in the middle of this old town.  To your north is some
kind of abandoned store and to the south is some kind of enterance way.  The
dusty road continues east and west.

rooms.name: A Dusty Road
rooms.desc:
This is just about the middle of this oly run-down place.  You can guess that
it was a pretty bust place back in its day, and from the look of it, its day
was a long, long time ago.  You can go north into some kind of enterance way
or south into a long abandoned store.  The dusty road continues east and
west.

rooms.name: A Dusty Road
rooms.desc:
You are in the eastern half of town, though not yet out of it yet.  Both to
your north and south apear to be some kind of abandoned stores.  The dusty
road leads west back into the heard of this dead place or east out of town.

rooms.name: A Dusty Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the edge of a dusty town on a dusty road.  You could swear
that you have been here before.  There is somekind of town to your west, but
there does not seem to be any activity.  You can go west into town or east out
on the dusty road.  The road to the east looks wierd somehow, you can't quite
place it... but something isn't right.  But it is probably nothing to be
worried about.

rooms.name: An Abandoned Store
rooms.desc:
Dust and more dust... that is about all that is in the former shop.  There is
no way to determine what was sold or bought here.  The doorway leands north
back to the main road.

rooms.name: A Lobby
rooms.desc:
This is or more specifically was a very luxurious looking loby.  There is
and expensive looking counter off to one side and a wide set of stairs
leading up.  The dust road is through a doorway to your north.

rooms.name: An Abandoned Store
rooms.desc:
There is nothing here... how strange.  A thick dust covers the floor.  There
is a small sign on one wall, though it is covered in grey dust.  To the north
is a doorway to the dusty road.

rooms.name: An Abandoned Store
rooms.desc:
This was once a fairly large shop.  There is a counter that almost surrounds
the center with only a small break for the door and one ta gain access to
behind the counter.  Dust covers the long since unused counter.  The door
to the north is the only exit.

rooms.name: An Office
rooms.desc:
Some place of business used to be here.  There are a few old style desks and
stools neatly placed around.  There is nothing else but the dust however.
It is kind of a strange place.  You can return to the top of the stairway by
heading east from here.

rooms.name: Top of the Stairs
rooms.desc:
You are at the top of the stairs here.  There are some sort of offices to your
east, west and south.  The lobby is just down the stairs.

rooms.name: An Office
rooms.desc:
This was some sort of working room.  There is a long counter along one side.
And a smallish table with two chairs off in the corner.  You can return
to the stairs by heading west from here.

rooms.name: An Office
rooms.desc:
This was probably a really nice place in its day.  Now it is just a tattered,
old, dusty place.  The carpeting is all britty and shotty.  There is a big,
old, dark wooden desk facing the door with a nice leather chair behind it.
Thers is a painting on one wall and that is about all.  Whoever used to work
here moved out and didn't leave a whole lot.  You can go back to the top
of the stairs by heading north.

rooms.name: A Machine Room
rooms.desc:
What a strange room, you are surrounded by black pipes, and wires, and all
sorts of other contraptions.  There is a hatch with a handle that is partially
open.  The only exit is back through the hatch to the east.

rooms.name: A Passenger Cabin
rooms.desc:
You are standing in some sort of an isle, kind of like you would be in a
church.  There are some major differences though, the seats are plush, and
individual, nothing like a bench or pew.  Some of the seats are facing each
othere with a small table seperating thim, like you be in a tavern or nice
resteraunt.  What a nice, clean, safe place it seems to be.

rooms.name: A Passenger Cabin
rooms.desc:
This room is very similar to the one you just exited.  Except there is
no exit to the outside, only east and west.  The same style seats are in
this room, as are some small tables.  Coctail tables perhapse?  It is all
very clean and seems very safe.
.

rooms.name: A Passenger Cabin
rooms.desc:
You are standing in some kind of isle.  There are plush seats lining
this inside of this long, fairly narrow room.  Between some of the seats
are some small tables.  I suppose one could put drinks or snacks on them.
The room seems to be set up for comfort.  It is clean, and apears safe.
There is an exit to the outside to your south, and there are two more
of these plush rooms just east and west of here.

rooms.name: A Passenger Cabin
rooms.desc:
This is another one of those long, plush rooms.  It boggles you why anyone
would need this much room, or this much comfort.  There are exits to the
east and west.  There is no way to get outside from here, maybe if you
go into another room you can.

rooms.name: A Passenger Cabin
rooms.desc:
You are in a long narrow room.  As you peer around you you note that this
room is a little different than those to your east or west.  This room
is half filled with plush chairs and little tables, but also has some kind
of dining area and a bar at one end.  Whoever used this place had plenty
of wealth.  You can go outside to the south or stay inside by going east
or west.

rooms.name: A Passenger Cabin
rooms.desc:
This is much like the rooms around it.  There are those same plush seats
and little tables.  Gosh, someone had to have been loaded to afford a place
like this.  Maybe they left some valuables for the taking?  You can leave
either to the east or the west.

rooms.name: A Passenger Cabin
rooms.desc:
This seems to be the end of a long set of rooms.  It is quite long but only
has an exit to the outside tou your self and a open doorway to the west.
There are a lot of plush seats in a aisle here.  Most are facing in one
direction, but some are facing each other with small tables between them.
Quite a nice place, and it seems fairly safe too.

rooms.name: A Boarding Platform
rooms.desc:
You are at the end of some kind of wooden platform.  There is a huge metal
tube like object to your north.  It could easily hold a lot of people, but
there is no enterance here.  There are a few boxes and crates around, but
they appear empty.  The only exit is to the east.

rooms.name: A Boarding Platform
rooms.desc:
You are on some kind of wooden platform.  There is a huge metal box like
tube that streches out east and west to your north.  There is a doorway to
the north that will allow you to enter it.  You can also stay on the
platform by going east or west.

rooms.name: A Boarding Platform
rooms.desc:
You are on a wooden platform facing a huge metal tube that streches out
east and west of you.  However, there is no enterance here, perhapse there
is one to your east or west.  The platform continues east and west, or you
can go south toward the road.

rooms.name: A Boarding Platform
rooms.desc:
You are on a wooden platform alongside a huge metal tube to the north.
There is an open hatchway to you north where you can enter the metal
object. You can also walk along it by staying on the platform and either
going east or west.  There is a building to your south, but you can not
enter it here.

rooms.name: A Boarding Platform
rooms.desc:
You are along side a large metal tube to your north.  There is not a way
in from here, perhaps there is one further along to the east or west.  There
is a doorway to your south, however.  It leads into a smallish building,
maybe it is an office.

rooms.name: A Boarding Platform
rooms.desc:
You are on a study wooden platform of somekind.  There is a large metal tube
thing that streaches out east and wst just to you north.  There is some
kind of doorway to the north as well.  To your south is a wooden building
but there is no doorway here, perhaps there is one east or west of here.

rooms.name: A Boarding Platform
rooms.desc:
You are nearing the end of a wooden platform.  To you north is a stange
metal tube thing.  There is no way in from here, perhaps to the east or
west. You can also go south, along side the buiding in the middle of the
platform.

rooms.name: A Boarding Platform
rooms.desc:
You are at the end of the wooden platform.  To your north is a large metal
tube, there is an opening alowing you to enter in that direction.  The
platform also leads off to the west, so you can follow it that way.

rooms.name: A Platform
rooms.desc:
You are on a large wooden platform of some kind.  There is a building off
to the east but there is no door to enter it from here.  To your north the
sun gleams off a large metal object.  Off to the south is a dirt road.

rooms.name: A Small Office
rooms.desc:
This is some sort of private managers office.  There is a decent sized wood
desk facing the door and a comfy looking chair behind it.  The only exit is
to the east.

rooms.name: An Office
rooms.desc:
You seem to be in the main room of some kind of office.  There is a smallish
counter off to one side and a few benches around.  Although it is abandoned,
or at least seems that way, it looks clean and well kept.  There are doors
to some kind of other rooms east and west of here.  You can go onto the
platform by heading either north or south.

rooms.name: A Small Storage Room
rooms.desc:
This is some kind of supply room.  There are a few buckets, mops, and other
cleaning supplies, along with a bunch of simple tools.  Whoever keeps this
place up must use these items.

rooms.name: A Platform
rooms.desc:
You are on a large wooden platform of some kind.  Off to your west is a
wooden building but there is no door here.  As you look north, your
vision is filled and captivated by a large metal tube like object.  Not
to far to your south is a plane dirt road.

rooms.name: A Platform
rooms.desc:
You are an a wooden platform of some kind.  Of to your south is a wide
dirt path, almost a road.  Farther off to the north is a large metal tube.
There is a smallish wooden building off to the north-west of here.

rooms.name: A Platform
rooms.desc:
You are between a small wood building to your north and a wide dirt path
to your south.  You see a door to the building just to the east.  Although
clean, there is nothing around here.  Seems fairly strange.

rooms.name: A Platform
rooms.desc:
You are at the doorway to a small building.  The wooden door is just to
your north.  You can go that way, or along the wall either to the east
or the west.  To the south is a wide dirt path, almost a road.  Gee this
place is quiet.

rooms.name: A Platform
rooms.desc:
You are between a small wooden building and a normal dirt road.  The door
to that building is north-west of here.  This place is very quite, but it
does not look unused.  Quite strange.

rooms.name: A Platform
rooms.desc:
You are an a wooden platform of some kind.  Of to your south is a wide
dirt path, no, actually it is more like a road.  To the north you see a
large metal tube.  It gleams in the light.  Off to the north-west is some
kind of wooden building.

rooms.name: A Large Path
rooms.desc:
You are just outside the direct view of the wooden platform, at least you
think you are... there is something very strange going on here, you just
can not think of what it is.

rooms.name: A Large Path
rooms.desc:
You are some kind of dirt road.  You can stay on the road by heading east
or west.  Opening to your north is a open wooden platform.  Farther off to
the north is some kind of large metal object.  A little less far away, but
more to the east is a wooden building.

rooms.name: A Large Path
rooms.desc:
This dirt road leads east and west from here.  To you north is a large
wooden platform.  There is a building and the light is glinting off of
something in that direction.

rooms.name: A Large Path
rooms.desc:
You are on a small dirt road, wait... you know you have been here before.
Ah yes, you remember now, this is where that strange doorway led you.  There
is still no trace of it.  The road leads east and west, and soem kind of
platform is to your north.

rooms.name: A Large Path
rooms.desc:
You are on a wide dirt road.  It continues east and west from here, leading
in front of some kind of large wooden platform, which can be reached by
heading north from here.  There is not much here, in fact it is very quiet.

rooms.name: A Large Path
rooms.desc:
You are on a small dirt road.  The road continues east and west from here.
To your north is a fairly large wooden platform.  A little to the north and
west is a wooden building.  And fairly far to the north is some kind of
metal tube like object.

rooms.name: A Large Path
rooms.desc:
You are just outside the direct view of the wooden platform, at least you
think you are... there is something very strange going on here, you just
can not think of what it is.

rooms.name: The North-Western Edge of a Circle
rooms.desc:
In this corner you are free of the inset circle.  This particular part of the
room has no dust in it, although it does not exactly looked "used".  You can
head either east or south, both come closer to the circle.

rooms.name: Northen Edge of a Circle
rooms.desc:
This is the northern edge of a rather large inset circle.  The purpose of
which is quite unclear.  Your best guess is that it is part of some magik
ritual. You can go south to the middle of the circle where some stairs leading
down are, or you can go east or west into corners of the room.

rooms.name: North-East Corner
rooms.desc: This description is yet unfinished...

rooms.name: Western Edge of a Circle
rooms.desc:
You are at the western edge of a large inset circle.  There is some force within
this circle.  You can feel it pulling at your soul.  Maybe it isn't such a good
idea to be up here.  You can go east into the middle of the circle, which does
not seem right, but that is where the stairs leadig down are.  Or you can go
north or south into corners of the room.

rooms.name: Middle of a Circle
rooms.desc:
You are in the middle of a large stone ring layed into the floor around you.
There doesn't seem to be a reason for it... unless... nahh... it couldn't be
for magiks could it?  Well you might want to move just to be safe, you can
head north, east, south, or west and stay in the large room.  Or you can go
down through the staircase in the middle.

rooms.name: North-West Corner
rooms.desc:
You are at a corner of the huge tower.  There is no visible source of light
buy you seem to be doing okey with it.  Since you are right along side the
wall, you can get a good look at its construction.  It is made up of very
regular peices of a uniform grey stone.  This would be an incredible 
construction project... if it were man made, but that is unlikely.  You
can go east and south from here, along the wall.

rooms.name: North Side
rooms.desc:
You are along the north wall of this huge open room.  It is quite an eiree
place.  One might think being this open and made of stone, there would
be a huge echo, thing is though... you can barely hear your own footsteps.
You can go south, east, and west from here.  The stairway up is to the
south-east.

rooms.name: North Side
rooms.desc:
You are along the northern wall of this huge stone room.  There is not much
here, it looks pretty empty.  But, it is quite dark and the light is making
the shadows dance, so who knows for sure?  You can go east back toward the
door, west toward the north-west corner, or south, where a huge stairway
leading up is.

rooms.name: North Side
rooms.desc:
You are up along side the north wall of this huge room.  It is a strangly
quiet place.  Too quiet perhapse? The north-east corner is to your east,
there is a large stairway leading up to the south-west, and far to the
west is a large wooden door.  You can go east, south, or west from here.

rooms.name: North=East Corner
rooms.desc:
You are in the far north-east corner of this huge stone room.  Although
it is quite dark in here, you can make out the enormous size of the place
just by catching glimpses.  There is a stairway in the middle of the room,
to the south-west, and you can head south or west along the walls.

rooms.name: A Courtyard
rooms.desc:
You are in a small courtyard, you know you have been here before...  There
was a portal here, wasn't there?  Either way, there isn't now and the only
exit is to the east.  This courtyard looked to be quite a place in its day,
but it is all dreary now.  There is a large wooden doorway leading to a
huge tower.

rooms.name: The Entrance Way
rooms.desc:
This is the main entrance to the old, large tower.  It isn't exactly like
any entrance you have ever seen before, however.  Really if it wasn't for
the large wooden door to the west, it would be just like any other part of
the room.  The room itself is absolutly huge.  It is built of some sort of
grey stone with support columns every few meters.  There is a stairway
leading up to the east.  You can go east, north, or south and stay in the
room or you can go west throught the doorway.

rooms.name: Middle of the Room
rooms.desc:
This is the middle of a huge room, which is just on this level.  To your
east are some stairs that lead up.  To the west is a huge wooden door.  You
can also go north and south from here.

rooms.name: Center of the Room
rooms.desc:
You are in the exact middle of this huge room.  There is a wide stairway
leading up from here, it seems to another large room.  You can also go in
any of the four cardinal directions.  There is a huge wooden door a ways to
the west.

rooms.name: Middle of the Room
rooms.desc:
You are in the western half of this huge stone room.  The ceiling towers
above you.  Just to your east is a huge stairway leading up.  You can
go east, north, west, or south from here.

rooms.name: East Side
rooms.desc:
You are up against the far wall of this huge room.  The stone wall towers
above you and reaches toward a dark ceiling.  There is a stairway leading
up to your west.  Much further west you can make out a large doorway.
You can head north, south, or west from here.

rooms.name: South-West Corner
rooms.desc:
You are in the south-west corner of the huge room.  The walls are perfectly
constructed, it is quite amazing.  There are some stairs off to the north-
east. And a large wooden doorway is north of here.  You can go north
or east.

rooms.name: South Side
rooms.desc:
You are along the south wall of the huge open room.  My gosh this place is
large. Quiet too.  Too quiet?  You can go north, east, or west from here.
There is a stairway to the north-east.

rooms.name: South Side
rooms.desc:
You are along the southern wall of this huge stone room.  The almost perfectly
uniform grey wall streaches far above you.  There is a stairway leading up
to your north.  You can also do east and west along the wall from here.

rooms.name: South Side
rooms.desc:
You are along the the south wall of a huge open room.  It is very quiet even
though the whole place is made of hard stone, even you feet arn't clapping
loudly as you think they might.  To the north-west is a stairway leading up.
You can go north, east, or west from here.

rooms.name: South-East Corner
rooms.desc:
This is the far south-east corner of the huge stone room.  Two walls of 
stone lead up into the darness.  There is a stairway leading up north-west
of here.  You can go north or west along the walls.

rooms.name: A Field
rooms.desc:
You are at the end of a large battlefield.  The portal from which you came is
not here.  Like it or not you have to find another way out.  It looks as
though some kind of battle has been going on for centuries.  The grass here
is basically non-existent and the bones of people killed long ago are only
partially buried.  There is some clanging in the air.

rooms.name: A Grassy Field
rooms.desc:
This is a corner of a large grassy field.  It does not quite look like a
field though, it has a more springy, luscious look to it.  You can go
north or east from here.  There is a small sign staked into the ground here.

rooms.name: A Tunnel
rooms.desc:
After you step out of the door way it seems to disappear.  You are left
peering down dark tunnel.  Since the door is gone you have no choice but to
leave to the east, the only exit.

rooms.name: A Dusty Road
rooms.desc:
The door from where you came has disappeared.  You are standing at the edge
of a old, dusty town on an equally dusty road.  You can go west into town
or east away from town, but the road to the east looks strange, wierd, oh,
it is probablly nothing to worry about.

rooms.name: A Large Path
rooms.desc:
You are on a wide dirt path, more of a road actually.  The portal from where
you came is no longer there.  Looks like you need to find another way out.
As you thought the road leads east and west from here.  And there is a large
wooden platform to your north.  You can see some sort of building in that
direction. You don't see a soul around.

rooms.name: A Courtyard
rooms.desc:
You have enterered a small courtyard, the portal from which you came is gone.
There is only one way out now, and that must be to the east.  There are some
old flower beds here, but everything is dead and withering, not much to look
at that is for sure.
